name: binder-clip
description: A binder clip with a broad tapered spring body and an upright wire handle.
useCase: Identify binder clips or removable paper fasteners.
misuse: Use a visible label when a tool identifies a product or a specific art material.

16.reason: The broad spring body stays open below the complete wire handle.

24.reason: The larger clip keeps a clear wire handle opening above its tapered body.
